claims.claim: Whoever becomes premier faces a projected deficit of about $13.8 billion, and the NDP, Conservatives and Greens have made competing tax promises.

claims.claim: The Greens propose a one-time wealth tax of 5 per cent above $50 million, 10 per cent above $100 million and 20 per cent above $1 billion, estimated to raise about $22.2 billion.
